messages:
maya: CI perf alert — canary for release r/3912 shows decode p95 jumped from ~120ms -> ~215ms. Regression hit on attention-heavy tail workloads. Noticed right after merge that touched kernel selector.

deploy-bot: :warning: Canary hold applied for r/3912 due to performance regression (rule: decode_p95 > 180ms).

anish: digging in. which jobs/showcases are reproducing? small-seq chat tests? long-seq?

maya: primarily short/med seqs (8-64 tokens) with mixed batch sizes. Repro in perf harness: `./perf/run --suite=chat_short --canary=r/3912`. Attn kernels show weird choice patterns.

cooper: can you paste the top lines from the profiler (nsight / perf-bench)? just summary please.

maya: pasted profiler snapshot: 
```
GPU kernel timeline: 
- attn_generic: 48% time (was 20%)
- attn_fused: 14% time (was 55%)
- memcpy_htod: 9% (was 3%)
- decode_loop_cpu: unchanged
GPU occupancy avg: 37% (was 78%)
KV cache memcopies increase: 3x
```

perf-bot: sampled trace attached: `trace_id=perf-1708456-22`. top event: kernel_selector::choose_by_entropy() -> attn_generic chosen for ~72% of short sequences.

lin: I ran a local bisect across merges. Blame narrows to commit 8f3d2b7 (selector: switch entropy heuristic to continuous scoring). That change encourages the "generic" kernel for mid-high entropy prompts; seems to flip choice for many short sequences.

cooper: that explains reduced occupancy: attn_generic has higher per-token overhead on our GPU path. Also causes more KV buffer resizing/memcopy since its layout differs.

anish: can we reproduce with a repro script? Try: `python tools/repro/choose_kernel_repro.py --seed=42 --seqs=1000 --config=r/3912` — it prints chosen kernel distribution.

maya: ran that locally: results: `attn_generic: 705 / 1000`, `attn_fused: 215 / 1000`. On baseline (pre-8f3d2b7) it was opposite.

lin: quick mitigation: add short-seq hard cutoff in selector: if seq_len <= 64 -> prefer attn_fused. I opened PR #4238 with the flag `selector.force_fused_short_seqs=true` and a unit test. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4238

anish: can we run canary with that flag enabled (no code revert) to validate?

maya: started canary with flag enabled on the same pool. Preliminary numbers: p95 decode = 118ms, p50 unchanged. KV memcopy back to baseline.

cooper: great. if PR fixes perf we should ship a hotfix before reverting the entropy change. Also add a regression test to CI: run kernel-chooser on sampled prompt set to assert fused fraction >= 40% for short seqs.

lin: added CI test in the PR. Also added a profiling hook to perf-bot so future samples dump the chosen kernel histogram.

maya: agreement: no full revert today; hotfix flag + CI guard. I'll monitor canary for a few hours and then propose rollout resume.

deploy-bot: Hold lifted for r/3912 — canary healthy after flag. Rollout resumed :white_check_mark:.

anish: follow-ups: (1) re-evaluate entropy scoring threshold — maybe biased; (2) measure cost delta of attn_generic to see if it has a valid use case for long sequences only; (3) instrument selector to record perf delta when it chooses non-fused.

cooper: noted. creating tracking ticket INF-1192 for the postmortem and long-term fix.

maya: thanks everyone. good catch.

lin: TL;DR: commit 8f3d2b7 changed kernel choice heuristic -> increased use of generic kernel on short seqs -> lower GPU occupancy + KV memcopy thrash -> decode p95 regression. Hotfix flag pinned fused kernel for short seqs, canary validated, rollout resumed.
